runtime_gate.unknown_task_ref: Suppress decisive H4/H5 and mark authority_conflict.
runtime_gate.ka_or_name_conflict: Suppress decisive H4/H5 and mark authority_conflict.
runtime_gate.no_task_ref: Allow H1-H3. Do not invent task/page references.

first_next_rule: For FIRST/NEXT/BEST questions, reason from scenario objective, available inputs, dependencies, stakeholder authority and current work state. Never use chapter-number order as a universal sequence.
page_rule: Return both printed_page and pdf_page_1based when a page is shown.
copyright_rule: Use structured facts, paraphrased summaries and short section/page pointers; never reproduce long passages from member-copy PDFs.
